_about: Abilities. One row = one ability script/resource. 'mechanic' names the existing Eslabong mechanic it is built on (found by reading the game); 'new' means new code. Cooldown in seconds; power is relative to the base class's normal attack.

rows.name: Power Armor
rows.effect: Absorbs the first 3 hits each round, then the armor breaks (sprite swaps to unarmored).

rows.name: Rad Feed
rows.effect: Heals 5% max health per second inside radiation and deals x1.25 damage while irradiated.

rows.name: V.A.T.S. Shot
rows.effect: Time slows for 1.5 s, then a locked-on shot hits the targeted enemy for x2.5 damage.

rows.name: Stim Toss
rows.effect: Throws a stimpak that heals allies in the splash radius for 30% max health.

rows.name: Ghoulified
rows.effect: Takes no damage from radiation hazards.

rows.name: Ground Slam
rows.effect: Slams the ground: x1.5 damage and a 1.2 s stun to enemies in the radius.

rows.name: Piercing Beam
rows.effect: Charges for 0.8 s, then fires a beam that passes through every enemy in a line for x2.0 damage.
